At work

I manage a City Transit division, and I build custom software for it when nothing off the shelf fits. Each project here has a write-up covering the problem, the tool and what I learned.

Projects

Driver scheduling system

An eight-week driver rotation and a dispatch board that works out coverage when someone calls in.
